episodes.synopsis: After receiving a text from the "Shepherd", Kakei gets has a sudden intuition that the girl he saw handing out posters is in danger and runs back to pull her out of the way, however they trip and Kakei accidentally gropes her breast, resulting in the news spreading that he is a molester.
episodes.title: Formation of the Library Club

episodes.synopsis: Kakei and the others start their Shiomi Happy Project activities by picking up trash and find a beautiful tuning fork...
episodes.title: Lost and Found

episodes.synopsis: Kakei and Suzuki get help from the genius of the cafeteria while Shirasaki and the others pay the Song Princess a visit…
episodes.title: Lonely Song Princess

episodes.synopsis: The Library Club members don costumes to advertise Appllio's Spring Fair and then take a trip to the bathhouse to get to know each other better…
episodes.title: A New Library Club

episodes.synopsis: The Library Club starts getting more jobs, but this spike in popularity has its drawbacks... Meanwhile, Kakei zeroes in on the Shepherd's identity.
episodes.title: The Truth Behind the Messages

episodes.synopsis: Kakei finally pays a visit to the magic library from his visions and learns more about the secrets of the Shepherds.
episodes.title: The Magic Library

episodes.synopsis: The girls of the Library Club invite Kakei out on a group date, but Kodachi has Shepherd work for him even on his day off.
episodes.title: The Library Club's Day Off

episodes.synopsis: Suzuki writes a play for the Library Club to perform, but will circumstances force her to confront her true self...?
episodes.title: The Magic Book

episodes.synopsis: As the Library Club prepares for the festival, Misono thinks back on her life of singing and decides what she wants for the future.
episodes.title: The Song Princess' Choice

episodes.synopsis: More is revealed about Kakei and Kodachi's past, and Kakei meets Shirasaki's little sister while Kodachi causes trouble.
episodes.title: Confession

episodes.synopsis: The Happy Project's Minafes goes head to head with the student council as Kakei makes his decision about being a Shepherd.
episodes.title: Decision

episodes.synopsis: It's finally the day of Minafes and the symposium. Which will get more people? Will Kakei be able to save Shirasaki?
episodes.title: A Good Librarian Like a Good Shepherd
